lines.text: Many learners say: Where you are from?
Are you! Where are you from?

native.tip: Soru kelimesinden sonra yardımcı fiil gelir: “Where are you from?”
native.caption: “Where you are from?” mi diyorsun? 😅 Türkçe sıra karışabilir; İngilizcede “are” önce gelir. Doğrusu “Where are you from?”. Carlos’u dinle ve tekrar et! Lexkite uygulamasını aç, daha çok pratik yap.
native.comment: Cevap: “are you”. Soruda are önce. Ücretsiz testle pratik yap: {link}

en.tip: After the question word, put the verb first: “Where are you from?”
en.caption: Do you say “Where you are from?”? 😅 The word order differs from Turkish: “are” goes first. The right sentence is “Where are you from?”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Open the Lexkite app and practice more.
